verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's bottle-in-cream-circle motif and a sensible top-to-bottom order, but the headline is too small for the canvas, the NEW pill floats off to the left and doesn't line up with the Try It button, and a faint stray circle sits in the top-left corner. B pulls the cream circle away from the bottle and leaves it as an orphan blob cut off in the bottom-left corner, so the brand motif is broken; the right column (headline, NEW, CTA) is spread out with big uneven gaps, and the bottom of the canvas is dead space.
